title: STELE
subtitle: directive compiler & integrity layer
body: The governance layer above the ledger: STELE compiles standing directives into per-project postures, so an AI collaborator inherits constraints as compiled state, not vibes. An integrity state machine watches the session — thirteen tripwires against role-flattening and authority drift, a hard lockout when integrity cannot be re-established, a full audit trail, and narrative export so the record leaves with you.
Stratum records what was decided. STELE constrains what a session is allowed to become — the axis that holds while the field distorts around it. Same thesis, opposite direction of enforcement.
